Developer may renovate Developer's Existing Building or construct a new building or buildings and improvements upon all or a portion of Developer's Land and possibly other properties that are owned by Developer or its affiliates or that hereafter may be acquired by Developer or its affiliates (said new or renovated building or buildings and improvements, togetherwith anyfurtherreplacements thereof or additions theretowhether madebyDeveloper or Developer's successors or assigns, being herein referred to collectively as “Developer's Proposed Building" and Developer's Land, Developer's Existing Building, Developer's Proposed Building and any and all buildings and improvements now or hereafter located on Developer's Land being herein referred to collectively as "Developer's Property").
